direct_edge_types.PARENT_CHILD: Explicit Parent_Master_ID relationship; reverse child discovery may be derived.
direct_edge_types.LINKED_PROCEEDING: Explicit canonical Master ID found in Linked_Proceedings.
direct_edge_types.APPEAL_REVIEW_ID_LINK: Canonical Master ID explicitly present in Appeal_or_Review.
direct_edge_types.SPECIALIST_SOURCE_EDGE: Future source-controlled relationship admitted through a specialist register and keyed to canonical Master IDs.

context_lenses.STREAM: Same recorded procedural track; navigation context only.
context_lenses.CONNECTION: Same exact non-empty recorded Connection value; context only unless separately supported as a procedural edge.
context_lenses.GEOGRAPHY: Same recorded geography; navigation context only.
context_lenses.CHRONOLOGY: Temporal proximity/order derived from Date_or_Period; not causation.
context_lenses.EVIDENCE_EVENT_ASSET_ACTOR: Only when independently source-controlled in the relevant evidence/event/asset/identity register.
context_lenses.SHARED_ASSET_CONTROL_CREDIT_HARM_CONTINU: Use where independent sources show that legally separate proceedings concern the same hotel/asset, control, exploitation, secured credit, estate value, productive unit, enforcement, income, title or alleged harm continuum. This is a material relevance lens, not joinder or liability.
context_lenses.FRAGMENTATION_ATOMISATION_AUDIT: Use to test whether compartmentalised treatment prevented a material cross-proceeding fact, filing, asset effect, criminal-harm allegation or evidential contradiction from being acknowledged elsewhere. It is an investigative/audit proposition requiring source- and actor-specific proof, not a presumed institutional motive.

implemented_public_views.REVERSE_TRACE: trace panel derives incoming relationships from explicit forward edges
implemented_public_views.WHY_CONNECTED: trace and Case Prism detail panels
implemented_public_views.CONVERGENCE_CLUSTER: Case Prism renders every proposition across the complete controlled lane denominator
implemented_public_views.FRAGMENTATION_AUDIT: exact-proceeding isolation fades all material outside the selected file and restores the full corpus
implemented_public_views.DECISION_DEPENDENCY_MATRIX: 18 x 12 explicit matrix with relationship, file treatment, sources, contrary record and consequences
implemented_public_views.PARALLEL_PROCEEDINGS_LANES: stable chronological swimlane table with one independent column per lane
implemented_public_views.ISOLATION_TEST: exact canonical proceeding selector, visible/disappearing comparison and full-corpus restore
implemented_public_views.AUDIENCE_LENS: nine reader lenses reprioritise questions without changing cells, sources or status
